what: Modelled armour sets, one per entry under sets: helm, pauldron, gauntlet and boot as separate Meshy pieces, a full-set model to fit them on, and a chest/legs skin; imported with the one command in each set's commands (tools/import_armor.py, docs/art-pipeline.md, Armour: modelled pieces). Piece files are meshy/armor/pieces/<set>_<kind>.glb, the skin <set>_skin.glb.

concepts.note: image-to-image (nano-banana-2) from meshy/base_a.png, same A-pose and framing
concepts.concept_b.png: 01a15563-90f6-7437-8010-7923d24bb8b5 (rugged iron and fur, horned helm: helm too close to Skyrim's, redo it before use)
concepts.concept_c.png: 01a15563-9d5b-75e0-baff-f60dd7b626b9 (footman, blue tabard: recolour before use, reads as Stormwind guard)
concepts.concept_k4.png: 01a1563d-e84a-7526-91a4-19ca17491304 (base_k4 with helm, pauldrons, gauntlets, boots added: set black_k); unused candidates concept_k1/k2 (01a1563c-0302-75cd-ad77-675497c99bd8, 01a1563c-0e10-7471-8166-321dce3c9cd3, on base_k2), concept_k3 (01a1563d-ddc1-700d-b6e6-6457e5f2e246)

plate_a.items: thornwarden_* (GameData.ITEMS); worn by Marshal Brannoc, sold by Corwin Hale
plate_a.method: separate pieces pulled out of concept_a with image-to-image, each image-to-3d, fitted onto the full-set model (plate_a_rig.glb) and mirrored; chest and legs a Meshy retexture of the hero styled on the base layer base_a6 (the base layer was pulled out of the concept afterwards)

piece_models.note: meshy-t2.5 smart topology, 1500-2000 tris; files meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_*.glb

plate_a.skin: 01a15612-a365-7302-b009-8a6c1d6a7434 (retexture of the hero model, original UVs, meshy-6, base_a6 as the style image) -> meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_skin.glb; before: 01a155d4-d106-73b5-9b8c-7d4f40a5a48c (concept_a as the style, unused/plate_a_skin_concept.glb)
commands: python tools/import_armor.py plate_a --helm meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_helm.glb --shoulder meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_shoulder.glb --glove meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_glove.glb --boot meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_boot.glb --fit meshy/armor/plate_a_rig.glb --skin meshy/armor/pieces/plate_a_skin.glb --match meshy/armor/concept_a.png
plate_a.shoulder_retexture_unused: 01a155d4-a936-75b2-91c0-d990054b282d (pauldron retextured from the concept: lost its brass trim; the original is used, tone-matched instead)

merc_d.method: as plate_a, from concept_d; base layer base_d5

commands: python tools/import_armor.py merc_d --helm meshy/armor/pieces/merc_d_helm.glb --shoulder meshy/armor/pieces/merc_d_shoulder.glb --glove meshy/armor/pieces/merc_d_glove.glb --boot meshy/armor/pieces/merc_d_boot.glb --fit meshy/armor/merc_d_rig.glb --skin meshy/armor/pieces/merc_d_skin.glb --match meshy/armor/concept_d.png

merc_d.cost: piece images 4 x 6, piece models 4 x 15, skin 10: 94 credits; base layers and their skins (both sets) 68 more
